documented_scope: Public source-led contrast experiment: one directly sourced conditional contribution prize and two Taiwan third-party procurement listings. No owner suitability, current bid eligibility, exact vendor requirements or payout is independently confirmed.

leads.title: Cognee Mergetober 2026 contribution competition

advertised_value.explanation: Highest-contribution prize; there is also a separate random draw of 20 US$100 prizes; neither is guaranteed.

leads.demand_summary: Event seeks original, solo integrations for Cognee; merged submissions may enter prize selection and contributors must follow issue assignment, code ownership, DCO, original-authored PR and blog requirements.
leads.reason_to_investigate: Integration building could exercise Atlas/Refinery connectors and produce public portfolio evidence even if no prize is won.
known_barriers: No issue assignment or confirmed author eligibility exists for our selected GitHub account.
Competition forbids AI-generated PRs and requires contributor-authored original code.
Winner count and prize process are conditional; no guaranteed paid issue or customer budget.
Submission must be opened within the campaign deadline and supporting blog/form requirements met.
leads.next_evidence: Inspect one unclaimed issue and rules; confirm solo original authorship, maintainers' assignment and expected time before any contribution.

leads.title: Taiwan Ministry of National Defense AI project management procurement

advertised_value.explanation: Listing reports 60m TWD allocation; not a payment offer to Atlas or verified eligibility.

leads.demand_summary: Third-party notice identifies a selective government service procurement for AI-assisted decision functionality project management with substantial scope and legal contractor requirements.
leads.reason_to_investigate: It is useful evidence that institutional AI integration/project management has purchasing demand, but not a plausible solo bid without independent qualification and tender document review.
known_barriers: Third-party listing is not the full authoritative tender pack; seek official PCC documents.
Selective procedure; bidding eligibility and invitation criteria are not established.
Contractor company registration, tax evidence, delivery capacity and security requirements may apply.
Project/program management scope appears significantly larger than our demonstrated delivery.
leads.next_evidence: Locate official tender CD15004L254 and decide whether legal eligibility, procurement stage, security and partnership capacity make any small subcontract realistic; otherwise archive.

leads.title: NCKU Hospital next-generation analysis system purchase

advertised_value.explanation: Third-party reported estimated tender value, not a software-service opportunity or cash receipt.

leads.demand_summary: A third-party listing identifies a next-generation laboratory analysis system purchase; this is not documented as a software research dashboard or a modular service bid.
leads.reason_to_investigate: Negative-control example: a real institutional data-analysis procurement can still be outside our product capabilities and should be rejected even with a large advertised budget.
known_barriers: Specific system/medical-laboratory supply needs are not covered by verified Atlas/HS delivery.
Authoritative procurement documents and equipment specifications were not obtained.
Deadline is near and supplier eligibility/after-sales service requirements are unknown.
leads.next_evidence: Reject for current business experiment unless an official document changes the system requirement and a qualified delivery partner is independently established.
